note: Tone/style only. Not policy. Not facts about Priya, Arvind, or Meher. Sample flights (e.g. SK-190) are unrelated.

samples.customer: My flight got cancelled and no one told me anything!
samples.agent: I completely understand the frustration — I can see flight SK-190 was cancelled due to operational reasons. I can rebook you on the next available flight at no extra cost, or process a full refund. Which would you prefer?

samples.customer: I want compensation, this delay ruined my whole day.
samples.agent: I'm sorry for the disruption. Your flight was delayed 3 hours 40 minutes, which qualifies for a meal voucher and lounge access under our policy. I've applied both to your account now.

samples.customer: This is unacceptable, I'm going to file a formal complaint and consider legal action over this.
samples.agent: I hear you, and I'm sorry this has been such a frustrating experience. I want to make sure this gets the right attention — I'm escalating this to our specialist support team right now, and they'll reach out to you directly.
